CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   C. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.

2. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Green, orange, and purple

3. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Netball.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Netball.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Netball.

4. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the volume
   D. Only the costume

5. Best practice when working on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Practise Roles of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.

6. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

   D. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.

8. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Guarantee a trophy

9. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   B. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   D. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.
   B. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.
   D. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.

11. Best practice when working on Middle Distance Races and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Middle Distance Races and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Middle Distance Races and Montage.
   C. Damage equipment used for Middle Distance Races and Montage.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Middle Distance Races and Montage.

12. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.
   C. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.

13. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   D. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

14. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming.

15. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft: (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Indigenous Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
